recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-17332 unless a future work group decision changes the current history Bundle response model.
issue_request: FHIR-17332 was Published with a Persuasive resolution. It reported that the RESTful history section recommended populating Bundle.entry.response.lastModified in history Bundles, but historical bdl-4 allowed Bundle.entry.response only for batch-response or transaction-response, and asked to loosen the constraint.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the change was already made under a different task. Git history shows c613b68f9b (GF#14550) changed the historical Bundle spreadsheet response invariant to include history, later bdl-4 FHIRPath updates preserved history, and 55512f8e09 refactored the old bdl-3/bdl-4 rules into the current bdl-3a through bdl-3d family.
additional_context: Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini. The current Bundle StructureDefinition no longer has bdl-4; bdl-3b requires history entries to have request and response elements, while Bundle.entry.response.lastModified remains a 0..1 response child. Current HTTP history examples and notes include response.lastModified. Related response metadata/status audits for FHIR-17420, FHIR-19619, and FHIR-23013 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the current source already permits and requires Bundle.entry.response on history entries, removing the blocker described by FHIR-17332.
